unit: replay audit event write (appendOrUpdate on event_id)
description: Replaying the same conflicting message twice produces exactly one replay audit row, because event_id is derived from the message id and the event write matches on event_id.
why_it_exists: QA - Replay Write Test appended events with hand-written distinct ids (EVT-FIRST-001, EVT-REPLAY-002), so every replay grew the Events tab and a genuinely repeating redelivery would have flooded the audit log. Round 3 of the guarded test re-runs the identical replay to prove the audit row is updated in place.

input.spreadsheet: created fresh per run; must not be SHEET_ID_PLACEHOLDER

payload.subject: Re: QA replay test SECOND DELIVERY
payload.summary: replay delivery with deliberately different content

payload.subject: Re: QA replay test SECOND DELIVERY
payload.summary: replay delivery with deliberately different content

assertions: One first delivery produces exactly one NEW_INBOUND event and zero events whose type contains DUPLICATE.
Two identical conflicting replays produce exactly one event whose type contains REPLAY, not two.
Communications row count, the compared content fields, Actions row count for the OWNER_DECISION key, and Matters.updated_at are all unchanged across both replays.
The event write uses appendOrUpdate matched on event_id; a deterministic event_id is what makes the audit row idempotent.
target_unresolved_reason: kind is "integration": not executed by harness/run.js.
